draft_queue.draft_text:
TIFF!! I "COPIED THE RIGHT CAT" AND MY WEBINAR PAGE IS LIVE 😭💗

Y'all, here's what I got done between last night's final work session and this morning's first one:

✅ Moved my speaking engagement work from ChatGPT into Claude on my iPhone, revised my pitches, and submitted my first conference talk proposal
✅ Finished my domain setup. Every link now lives under ONE address, thenailbawse.com, just like Tiff recommends
✅ Revised my email marketing system to fit where my business actually is right now, instead of paying for more than I need
✅ "Copied the right cat" 🐈 My webinar landing page and thank-you page are live on my own domain, and sign-ups save straight to my site
✅ Connected Gmail, Calendar, Zoom and Wix to Claude, so my daily community and webinar check-ins run without me copying and pasting between apps

See it here 👉🏽 https://thenailbawse.com/webinar
(Screenshots of the landing page, thank-you page and my appointment card graphic below 👇🏽)

Still in progress: my two-step checkout form and my confirmation email. I'm not calling those done until I test them.

Biggest lesson: one home base changes everything. When every link points to the same place, I stop rebuilding and start building.

Tiff keeps handing us the blueprint. I'm building it to fit my life.

For those of you already running webinars: what's the one thing in your confirmation email that actually gets people to show up live?
